scope: Pure nonlinear RIGID BODY pendulum diagnostic only; no bridge model or support modified.

test_definition.fixture: Isolated physical single-axis Y pin; its reference translations and ROTX/ROTZ are fixed, while ROTY is solved. These fixture restraints are never copied to the bridge.
test_definition.native_elements: One MASS element and one nonlinear RIGID BODY; no beam, shell, cable, rotational spring or preprocessor-created beam knot.
test_definition.analytic_branch_scope: Nearest-initial stationary angle; below-hinge gravity has positive potential curvature and above-hinge gravity has negative curvature. Newton convergence to the above-hinge branch would not establish stability.
test_definition.diagnostic_question: Can a native nonlinear rigid MPC support a stable gravity-restored pendulum under a nonzero transverse force, without any material stiffness to mask its geometric tangent?
test_definition.comparison_limit: This fixture isolates nonlinear rigid-MPC behavior and cannot prove the full bridge or either corrected floor fixture stable or unstable.
